summary.intent: Run the audit-fix pipeline against cipher-box UAT/verification findings to classify issues as auto-fixable vs manual-only, then autonomously fix auto-fixable issues with test verification and atomic SSH-signed commits.
summary.outcome: F-03 (BYO status flag wiring in StorageTab) was fully fixed, tested, and committed with a signed commit. F-04 (MigrationProgress stale UI) and F-05 (migration double-counting) were fixed by executor agents and tests passed, but the F-04 commit attempt failed due to a wrong working directory at session end, leaving those changes uncommitted.

repo: SSH commit signing is enforced on PRs — unsigned commits are not acceptable and --no-gpg-sign cannot be used
Commit signing uses 1Password's op-ssh-sign; the 1Password desktop app must be running and unlocked for git commits to complete
Commits trigger lint-staged hooks adding ~15s per commit attempt
Direct commits to main are not permitted; feature branches are required
Three UAT findings (duplicate MetricsService imports, fetch binding fix, orphaned FUSE files) were already resolved on main before the session began
Web package has 23 tests, all passing at baseline; migration specs are in apps/api

code.finding: F-03 fix: save flow now calls vaultControllerSetByoStatus({ isByo: mode !== 'cipherbox' }) after successful pinning-config save (non-fatal on failure); subsequent fetchQuota() picks up the advisory flag for the badge
F-04: Component had stale rendering for failed migration jobs with no polling restart logic when migration enters a failed state
F-05: Migration batch processor had double-counting in timeout calculations; also contains updateProgress and migration entity column definitions relevant to UI state

workflow: When 1Password SSH signing hangs in git commit: kill op-ssh-sign and the git commit process, restart 1Password, then retry — the hang is the signer unable to reach the 1Password agent socket
Sandboxed shell environments block op-ssh-sign from reaching the 1Password agent; signed commits must be run in an unsandboxed shell
After running jest inside a subdirectory (e.g., apps/api), the shell cwd stays in that directory — git commit must be run from repo root

Audit-fix classification heuristic: specific file+line + clear single-file change → auto-fixable; words like 'consider'/'design'/ambiguous scope/cross-cutting concerns → manual-only; err on manual-only when uncertain

friction: 1Password SSH signing hung multiple times — op-ssh-sign blocked waiting for authorization that never surfaced as a visible system prompt
Sandboxed Bash tool prevented op-ssh-sign from reaching the 1Password agent, requiring an explicit unsandboxed retry
Required three separate commit attempts and a 1Password app restart before signing succeeded for F-03
Shell cwd was left in apps/api after running jest, causing the F-04 commit attempt from the wrong directory to fail with exit code 128
open_items: F-04 (MigrationProgress stale failed-job rendering and polling restart) and F-05 (migration batch timeout double-counting) fixes are in the working tree but uncommitted — need commit and push
F-08 (orphaned Phala secrets in GitHub staging environment) — manual-only, requires developer attention outside this pipeline
Branch fix/audit-f03-byo-status-wiring is local only — needs to be pushed and a PR opened

Pre-existing uncommitted files (.planning/REQUIREMENTS.md, .planning/phases/18-performance-instrumentation/18-VALIDATION.md, Cargo.lock, apps/api/src/metrics/http-metrics.interceptor.spec.ts) are present on the branch and were not addressed
